    """
    Convert a NumPy / pandas type to its corresponding json_table.

    Parameters
    ----------
    x : np.dtype or ExtensionDtype

    Returns
    -------
    str
        the Table Schema data types

    Notes
    -----
    This table shows the relationship between NumPy / pandas dtypes,
    and Table Schema dtypes.

    ==============  =================
    Pandas type     Table Schema type
    ==============  =================
    int64           integer
    float64         number
    bool            boolean
    datetime64[ns]  datetime
    timedelta64[ns] duration
    object          string
    categorical     any
    =============== =================
    """
    from pandas.api.types import (
        is_integer_dtype,
        is_float_dtype,
        is_bool_dtype,
        is_numeric_dtype,
        is_string_dtype,
        is_object_dtype,
    )
    from pandas.core.dtypes.dtypes import (
        DatetimeTZDtype,
        PeriodDtype,
    )
    import pandas.core.common as lib

    if is_integer_dtype(x):
        return "integer"
    elif is_bool_dtype(x):
        return "boolean"
    elif is_float_dtype(x) or (is_numeric_dtype(x) and not is_integer_dtype(x)):
        return "number"
    elif lib.is_np_dtype(x, "M") or isinstance(x, (DatetimeTZDtype, PeriodDtype)):
        return "datetime"
    elif lib.is_np_dtype(x, "m"):
        return "duration"
    elif isinstance(x, ExtensionDtype):
        return "any"
    elif is_string_dtype(x) or is_object_dtype(x):
        return "string"
    else:
        return "any"
